issue_context.title: Inconsistencies between ECMA and HTML mininfier
issue_context.body:
I was learning how to minify JS files from the [ECMA minifier CLI](https://github.com/swc-project/swc/blob/7437f53047853dad28d5b0274137a4167e74976c/crates/swc_ecma_minifier/src/cli/bin.rs). It uses all three transforms, the `resolver`, `hygiene` and `fixer`.

I discovered that the HTML minifier, [when it minimizes JS](https://github.com/swc-project/swc/blob/9d793f1cd3f2e23ba5b286783e0633a13690f1c2/crates/swc_html_minifier/src/lib.rs#L1452-L1571), only uses the `resolver` transform.

Is this intentional? Or a bug?
comments:
It's a bug.
It should use fixer
This closed issue has been automatically locked because it had no new activity for a month. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue with the steps to reproduce. Thank you.

review_comments: So it should only apply `fixer` but not `hygiene`? I would like to understand why.

Boxing it twice wasn't necessary.
Happy to clean this up by importing `JsWriter` and `omit_trailing_semi`? Was trying not to change too much.
